doc.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

chapter: Los Angeles, college and the Air Force
title: Moving to Los Angeles and college
summary: He came to LA via his aunt, studied at City College, UCLA, started working downtown, and met Lennie Niehaus and Irving Bush.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Why did you come to Los Angeles?

Well my aunt had come out from Florida, and she was teaching swimming at the Ambassador Hotel, so I came to teach swimming and go to college, I wanted to go to USC, and I went there and I went to City College and UCLA.

Yeah. Always music. And I started working right away on Main Street downtown, little jobs. And I met Lennie Niehaus and a lot of great players, Irving Bush who’s a friend of mine still, we’ve been friends for 50 years now. He was the first trumpet player for the Philharmonic, and he played for Nat Cole and all, a great trumpet player. So we met in college at City College, and I’ve known him all that time.
